body:
**SEBI settlement order (primary source)** — [SEBI Settlement Order SO/AA/EFD2/2023-24/7081, 25 May 2023](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2023/1685095933750.pdf)
- Applicants: Mansun Consultancy Pvt Ltd (incorporated 30 Jun 2017; the Sundars own 50% each), P R Sundar, and Mangayarkarasi Sundar.
- SEBI acted on two references alleging advisory without registration. His website prsundar.blogspot.com (posts since 27 Aug 2013) had an "Advisory" tab saying: "Daily calls on Telegram: We will be giving daily calls on what positions to take, adjustments, etc." It also carried a Razorpay payment link, and the bank KYC described the business as "share marketing consultancy".
- A sample of January 2021 recommendations was found to be "investment advice" under the IA Regulations 2013. The alleged violation was Section 12(1) of the SEBI Act read with Reg 3(1) of the IA Regulations.
- Fees collected: ₹4,36,42,503 via Razorpay plus ₹23,53,260 by direct credit, for a total of ₹4,59,95,763.
- Timeline: SCN 17 May 2022 and supplementary SCN 8 Nov 2022. Settlement applications 9 Dec 2022, revised terms 2 Feb 2023, HPAC 22 Feb 2023, approved by Whole Time Members 3 Apr 2023, order passed 25 May 2023.
- Terms: ₹15,60,000 each (₹46,80,000 total), plus disgorgement of ₹6,07,69,863 (fees plus ₹1,47,74,100 interest at 12% from 1 Jun 2020 to 2 Feb 2023). They must refrain from buying, selling or dealing in securities for one year from the order. The settlement was "without admitting or denying the findings of fact and conclusions of law".
- Media framed it as "In a first, SEBI acts against finfluencer" — [Zee Business](https://zeebiz.com/market-news/news-in-a-first-sebi-bans-finfluencer-pr-sundar-for-violating-investment-adviser-norms-mansun-fine-settlement-237403); [Storyboard18](https://www.storyboard18.com/how-it-works/in-a-first-sebi-acts-against-finfluencer-pr-sundar-options-trader-not-allowed-to-trade-for-a-year-8483.htm). The probe was reported in Nov 2022 — [Business Standard, 29 Nov 2022](https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/sebi-launches-investigations-against-finfluencer-purisai-rajamani-sundar-122112901285_1.html). Sundar reportedly called it a two-year-old matter from when he was associated with a SEBI-registered advisory company (his own framing) — [via search summary of BS](https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/sebi-launches-investigations-against-finfluencer-purisai-rajamani-sundar-122112901285_1.html). Online critics mocked "bad calls and heavy fees" — [Business Today, 26 May 2023](https://businesstoday.in/markets/top-story/story/karma-finally-got-hold-of-pr-sundar-say-netizens-as-finfluencer-faces-sebis-wrath-383063-2023-05-26)
- Later finfluencer cases show the trend: "Baap of Chart" (Nasiruddin Ansari) was barred and ordered to refund ₹17 crore — [BQ Prime](https://www.bqprime.com/law-and-policy/sebi-bars-baap-of-chart-finfluencer-orders-rs-17-crore-refund). In Dec 2025 an interim order against Avadhut Sathe's trading academy impounded more than ₹546 crore — [JusCorpus](https://www.juscorpus.com/educators-or-unlicensed-advisers/)

`case_study:tata-elxsi-2009-2022` · tickers: TATAELXSI · confidence: verified

₹38.3 (Mar 2009) → ATH ₹10,238 (Aug 2022) ≈267x; standalone P/E 4.9 → 103 (21x) × implied EPS ~12.7x, so about 54% of the log-return was rerating. The last leg, ₹599 (Mar 2020) → ₹10,238 in 2.4 years (17x), had TTM EPS only ~2.5x and P/E 15 → 103. Drawdowns: −78% (2007–09), −53% (2016), −59% (2018–20). Then −70% to ₹3,093 (Oct 2026); ₹3,725 on 19 Nov 2026 (−64%), even though EPS is ~16% above the 2022 level (TTM ₹99.7 → ₹115.7). Early signal (2013–15): pivot to automotive/media design-and-technology services; OPM 18% → 26%, ROCE 40–60%, zero debt, still at P/E ~20 in 2014. Ended: FY26 revenue flat (₹3,729 cr → ₹3,757 cr), 9M FY26 revenue −2% YoY with EBITDA margin −534 bps, the transportation vertical (largest, JLR-heavy) weak on global auto spending cuts, and AI-disruption fears for ER&D services; brokers cut targets (MOSL Sell ₹3,100, Jul 2026). Lesson: a rerating-only leg (P/E ~7x in two years) reverses fully when growth stalls; a 100x P/E on ~25% growth did not allow for an auto downcycle or client concentration.

Key data: **start_year**: 2009; **end_year**: 2022; **start_price**: 38.3; **end_price**: 10238; **price_nov2026**: 3725; **multiple**: ~267x (17x in 2020-22); **pe_start**: 4.9; **pe_end**: 102.7; **eps_multiple_implied**: ~12.7x; **max_drawdown**: -59% in run; -70% after; **early_signals**: margin/ROCE inflection 2014-15 at ~20x; **ended**: revenue stall FY26, auto spend cuts, AI fears; **lesson**: rerating-only legs round-trip

Sources: <https://www.screener.in/company/TATAELXSI/> · <https://businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/tata-group-stock-down-37-in-9-months-brokerage-sees-22-upside-recommends-buy-522515-2026-03-26> · <https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/tata-elxsi-shares-hit-five-year-low-time-to-buy-sell-or-hold-544505-2026-07-22> · <https://www.indiainfoline.com/news/companies/tata-elxsi-hits-a-new-52-week-low-of-3945-00-driven-by-ai-disruption-fears-weigh-on-it-stocks>

body:
- **Low candour index, few misses.** Only 2 of 24 shortfalls were admitted unprompted (water receivables, Oct-25 opening; the Fasttel exit, May-26 opening). With so few misses, the index is noisy (Skipper 12.5% on 32, KEC 31% on 45). The pattern matters more than the number.
- **KPIL's habit is selective recall, not silence.** Three times a target was restated downward without comment, and each time the outcome then cleared the lower bar:
  - order inflow 26,000-28,000 -> "we stick to our guidance of 25,000 crores plus" (Oct-25);
  - standalone PBT 5.25-5.5% -> "5% to 5.5%" (Aug-25);
  - FY26 revenue "25%+" -> recalled as "20% to 25%" (May-26).

  None changes a status, because the outcomes met the original targets in the first two cases. But it is the same reflex as Skipper's "the 25% ... was our aspirational growth", applied with more room to spare.
- **Adjusted metrics carry the margin story.** Standalone FY26 PBT was 5.9% "excluding exceptional items and a one-off dividend income from VEPL", but 4.9% on reported numbers (screener 1,143 / 23,210) after the INR 515 cr Fasttel write-off. The guidance was met on the company's definition only; the record is single-source.
- **Basis shift on EPS.** "Minimum INR 50" (May-25), when the stated base (~INR 40) was standalone, became "consol EPS exceeding INR 50" in Feb-26. Standalone came in at INR 49 (98%: delivered by the threshold) and consolidated at INR 61.
- **Guidance is volunteered and conservative.** FY guidance sits in the opening remarks every May, with mid-year updates, and those promises delivered 91%, against 58% for Q&A answers. FY27 guidance (~15%+ revenue, +75 bp consolidated PBT, >30,000 cr inflow) was set below the FY26 run-rate.

**How to use this.** KPIL's group revenue, PBT, NWC and finance-cost guidance can be taken close to face value; the record supports it on two sources. Haircut dates on asset sales and collections by 1-2 quarters, treat capex guides as floors, and give subsidiary and new-geography targets (Fasttel, LMG IPO timing, international railways or water) about half credit. Read the standalone PBT on a reported basis as well as the adjusted one.

**Rule output: size 0** — EV 0.89x anchored (raw 0.74x) vs hurdle 1.76x. Gates: S2 passed (7/7), PEAD clear (Q3), survival clear,
4 open soft flags with a variant view. Probabilities (5 yrs): P(≥3x) model 0.8% vs base 21.3%; P(≤0.5x) model 37.9% vs 11.3%
(anchored 24.6%); P(blow-up) 10% vs 15.4% (anchored 12.7%). The card printed the **anchoring-lowered** warning (P(≤0.5x)): our raw
tail rests on company evidence (entry P/E 1.9x own median, own 2015 and 2018 collapses), so the raw tail is the honest number.
**Calibration concern (written before scoring):** P(≥3x) 0.8% is probably too low — this stock went 41 → 522 (12.7x) in 2020–23 and
18 → 208 in 2016–17. The lognormal σ=0.40 and three scenarios cannot reproduce commodity-cycle right tails, and the card anchors only
the left tails (L43). If the ≥3x call resolves YES, that is the lesson, not bad luck.
